plugins.name: mobile-web-correctness
plugins.description: Checklist of mobile web frontend gotchas (iOS input zoom, on-screen keyboard / visualViewport, fixed-overlay page-bleed, iOS scroll-lock, dvh, safe-area) to apply before shipping mobile UI.

plugins.name: browser-modes
plugins.description: Pick the right browser-automation mode before any Playwright/web task — headless (default, invisible), a visible window when login/auth is needed, or handover to the user's real already-open Chrome only when asked. Stops agents narrating a headless browser as if the user can see it.

plugins.name: app-review-scraper
plugins.description: Download every public review for one or more mobile apps from the iOS App Store and Google Play, store it locally as normalized JSON/CSV, and run a first-pass analysis (rating distribution, trend over time, complaint themes). Uses the fast no-credential paths first (Apple RSS JSON, google-play-scraper) and treats browser scraping as a last resort.

plugins.name: meeting-recorder
plugins.description: Record any call locally on Linux (mic + system audio as separate channels, no bot), transcribe on-device with whisper.cpp (Vulkan GPU when available, speaker labels, silence skipping), then let Claude summarise in the language spoken, propose a CRM entry or a Google Doc in the right Drive folder, and share it read-only with attendees only after two explicit confirmations. Work/personal profiles. Audio never leaves the machine.
